name: Vendor Refill
summary: Tops up your food, drinks and reagents to the count you choose whenever you visit a vendor that sells them.
logoPrompt: A small wooden supply crate with its lid propped open, neatly filled with corked glass bottles of clear water and round loaves of bread, a single gold coin leaning against its front

cover.tagline: Never run out of water again.
bullets: One chat line with the cost

description: **Vendor Refill keeps your consumables stocked: you set how many of an item you want, and every vendor that sells it fills your bags back up to that count.**
## Features
- A list per character: each item with the count you want to carry.
- Buys just what is missing at any vendor that sells it, a few purchases at a time.
- Respects bundles, the vendor's limited stock and your gold. Items that cost a currency other than gold are left alone.
- One chat line with what was bought and the gold spent, plus a note when gold ran short.
## How to use
Shift-click an item into chat after `/vr add`, followed by the count, for example `/vr add [Water] 20`. An item ID works too. `/vr list` shows your list.
## In detail
### Your list

Food, drink, reagents or anything else a vendor sells for gold can go on the list, and each character has its own. `/vr add` takes an item link or an item ID plus a count from 1 to 1000. Adding the same item again sets the new count.
### Restock at the vendor

When you open a vendor that sells something on your list, Vendor Refill counts what is in your bags and buys the difference. Items sold in bundles are bought in whole bundles, so you may end up a few over your count. Limited stock is respected, and sold out items and items that cost a currency other than gold are skipped. It makes four purchases at a time with a short pause between them.
### Gold
Before buying, it works out what your gold can pay for. The first chat line names every item bought and the gold spent. If the gold did not reach, a second line lists what is still missing.
### Commands
- `/vr` – shows whether refilling is on, how many items are on your list, and the commands.
- `/vr add <item> <count>` – keeps that many of the item in your bags.
- `/vr remove <item>` – takes the item off your list.
- `/vr list` – shows your list, sorted by name.
- `/vr on` or `/vr off` – switches refilling on or off for all your characters.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail. No combat data, which the Midnight expansion hides from addons. It only acts while a vendor is open.
- The addon is in English.
- Hold Shift while you open a vendor to skip one visit.
- Only your bags count, not the bank. It only buys, it never sells.
- Lists are saved per character until you change them.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
